purpose: Reusable, privacy-safe human acceptance and performance journeys derived from the 0.1.9 tester session.

scenarios.title: Local file discovery and document understanding positive control
scenarios.objective: Find the latest matching local document, identify it exactly, read its structure and content, and answer a follow-up without asking the user to repeat the target.
scenarios.fixture: Isolated workspace with multiple revisions of PDF, XLSX, DOCX, and image files.
acceptance: exact latest file identity
correct document facts and structure
follow-up retains the selected target
no visible Browser
no unnecessary approval

scenarios.title: Large folder organization from plan through verified move
scenarios.objective: Classify hundreds of files into existing destination categories, preserve ambiguous items for review, execute the reversible move, save a movement receipt, and verify destination counts.
scenarios.fixture: Isolated Downloads-like directory with at least 400 synthetic files and ambiguous cases.
acceptance: no fixed numeric cap stops a progressing route
ambiguous files are not guessed
movement receipt maps every changed file
read-after-write count verification
no source loss or duplicate move

scenarios.title: Program analysis into a reusable knowledge page
scenarios.objective: Inspect one local program, create a concise nondeveloper guide in a connected knowledge service, attach the install artifact when supported, and verify the written page.
scenarios.fixture: Synthetic application folder and isolated writable knowledge-service loopback.
acceptance: analysis remains tied to one program identity
page write is acknowledged and read back
unknown write effect is observed before retry
no fixed cap stop while novel Evidence continues
result is useful to a nondeveloper

scenarios.title: Telegram inbound attachments and caption become one T5 turn
scenarios.objective: Receive XLSX, PDF, DOCX, and JPG attachments sent through an allowed Telegram chat together with the user's caption and make them available to the normal Attachment Hand.
scenarios.fixture: Loopback Telegram Bot API with four safe fixture files and a caption.
acceptance: document, photo, caption, file identity and media group are preserved
downloaded bytes are registered in AttachmentStore
caption remains the user message
multiple attachments bind to one conversation turn
unsupported or oversized input is reported without loss of the caption

scenarios.title: T5 sends an existing or generated file through Telegram
scenarios.objective: Send an exact user-requested local or generated artifact through the already bound Telegram chat using the official Messenger Hand.
scenarios.fixture: Loopback Telegram Bot API and exact managed PDF, PNG, HTML, and XLSX artifacts.
acceptance: sendDocument or appropriate official Bot API method is owned by the provider
model receives file identity but never the bot secret
authority binds the exact destination and file
message and file identity are confirmed in a delivery receipt
same delivery is not repeated after unknown effect

scenarios.title: Remote channel recovery without console-only controls
scenarios.objective: From Telegram, correct, cancel, resume, or start a genuinely new task after a stopped run without needing access to the console recovery card.
scenarios.fixture: Bound loopback messenger session with a progressing task and an intentionally stopped task.
acceptance: new user input is durably admitted
model distinguishes correction, follow-up, cancel, and new work
conversation history is preserved
stopped execution state does not poison the next task
no command syntax is required from the user

scenarios.title: Connector secrets never become model or Terminal material
scenarios.objective: Use Telegram and knowledge-service credentials through their official secret boundary while still completing the requested action.
scenarios.fixture: Loopback connectors with canary credentials stored only in the platform secret adapter.
acceptance: secret absent from Conversation, Context, Run, command, stdout, error and artifact
general Terminal cannot read connector credentials
provider can use the secret without exposing it to the model
credential rotation does not lose the user task
raw screenshots containing credentials are never retained

scenarios.title: Connection identity distinguishes T5 from another application
scenarios.objective: Tell the user exactly which application, account, transport, permission scope, and resource set are connected before using a knowledge service.
scenarios.fixture: T5 OAuth connector and a separate external application connector with different permissions.
acceptance: connection owner and transport are explicit
connected does not imply every page is shared
external application configuration is not reported as a T5 connection
current capability is observed rather than inferred from old login state
installation preserves prior T5 state only when the same user state is intentionally retained

scenarios.title: Knowledge-service write is settled by read-after-write
scenarios.objective: Create or update a page, preserve unknown effects, and report success only after the exact page is read back with the requested content.
scenarios.fixture: Writable loopback knowledge service with interruption before and after effect acknowledgement.
acceptance: write request, acknowledgement and page identity are distinct
unknown effect is not replayed blindly
exact page is reopened and requested blocks are found
missing permission is reported as connection scope, not authentication failure
no success claim from model completion alone
